不确定时宁可先听，不要贸然发射干扰他人。: If you are unsure, rather keep listening than transmit rashly and interfere with others.
便携、功率小（约 5W），入门与本地通联。: Portable with low power (about 5 W); for getting started and local contacts.
先守听本地中继与常用频率，熟悉通联流程与规范。: First listen to the local repeaters and common frequencies to become familiar with operating procedures and practice.
先报「CQ CQ CQ，这里是 <你的呼号>，请讲」。: Start with "CQ CQ CQ, this is <your callsign>, please come back".
入门建议先入手持对讲机或双段手台，熟悉本地中继。: For a start it is advisable to get a handheld transceiver or a dual-band handheld and get to know the local repeaters.
全球 DX 通联核心设备，需对应等级操作证。: The core equipment for worldwide DX, and it requires the corresponding class of operating certificate.
养成记录通联日志的习惯，为后续 DX 与奖状打基础。: Make a habit of logging your contacts; it lays the groundwork for later DX and awards.
凭操作证申请业余无线电台执照，取得个人呼号。: With the operating certificate, apply for an amateur station licence and obtain your personal callsign.
功率 25–50W，装车或作基地台。: 25–50 W, installed in a vehicle or used as a base station.
功率大、功能全，配好天线远距离通联。: High power and full features; with a good antenna it works long distances.
呼号报读规范、用语简洁，从本地中继开始第一次呼叫。: Give your callsign correctly and keep it brief; make your first call through a local repeater.
在当地无线电管理机构报名，考取 A 类操作证（最低一级）。: Register with your local radio regulatory body and sit the exam for the class A operating certificate (the entry level).
收到回应后报对方呼号、信号报告（如 59/599）、姓名与位置。: When someone replies, give their callsign, a signal report (e.g. 59/599), your name and location.
结束时报 73 或「祝好」，简洁礼貌。: Finish with 73 or "best wishes" — brief and courteous.
